answer: VDF-gated staking at the ocean: each identity must burn a sequential VDF proof (e.g. 10^7 squarings, ~40s, unparallelizable). Nectar accrues only to proven-time addresses, weighting rewards by compute actually spent. Sybils face a haven problem: N identities cost N×40s plus N stakes serially, so farming 1000 IDs burns 11 hours of wall-clock and 1000 stakes before any payout — linear revenue, linear-plus cost. This works because time cannot be bought in bulk or parallelized, making identity creation strictly cost-dominated.
